title: Mixed-State Topology in Non-Hermitian Systems
summary: Non-Hermitian (NH) systems, owing to the existence of exceptional point (or ring and surface), exhibit exotic topological features which are inaccessible in Hermitian systems. While current studies on NH topology has primarily focused on pure states at zero temperature, the topological properties of mixed states remain largely unexplored.
